scoring_anchors.0: Missing, unsupported, or unusable for this dimension.
scoring_anchors.1: Major facts or links are wrong; a reviewer cannot rely on it.
scoring_anchors.2: Partially useful but an important scene element, evidence link, action, boundary, or explanation is missing.
scoring_anchors.3: Complete and reliable with only minor clarity or specificity gaps.
scoring_anchors.4: A cold reader can verify and act on it without reconstructing missing context.
